Name: Site water balance
Definition: Cumulative water available through the year; capped by soil available water holding capacity
Notes: kg->L conversion performed using the water-density identity (1 kg/m^2 ≈ 1 L/m^2 ≈ 1 mm, density ~1000 kg/m^3); this is a liquid water equivalent, not the actual density of vapour or snow. The accumulation period is descriptive only: a capped cumulative is not a plain accumulation, so dividing by the year would not give a meaningful mean rate. Being a balance is NOT the reason - cmi is a balance too and is read as a rate; it is the cap that makes the mean meaningless here
